solutions.explanation:
Pair the smallest number with the largest. Moving inward increases one number by \(1\) and decreases the other by \(1\), so each pair has the same sum:
\[
\begin{aligned}
&(90+99)+(91+98)+(92+97)\\
&\qquad +(93+96)+(94+95).
\end{aligned}
\]
These five pairs use every number from \(90\) through \(99\) exactly once. Each pair totals \(189\), so the sum is \(5\times189=945\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
